description: This Java source file defines the final class VoicemailProviderHelpers which implements the VoicemailProviderHelper interface. It provides methods to interact with voicemail data stored via Android content providers, including insert, update, delete, query, and content setting functionalities, along with helper methods for data conversion and processing.

classes.name: VoicemailProviderHelpers
classes.description: A helper class implementing VoicemailProviderHelper to perform CRUD operations and data access on voicemail entries via Android content providers.

methods.name: createFullVoicemailProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance with full access to all voicemails, requiring appropriate permissions.

methods.name: createPackageScopedVoicemailProvider
methods.description: Creates a scoped instance limited to voicemails created by the app’s package.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new voicemail record into the content provider.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing voicemail record identified by URI.

methods.name: setVoicemailContent
methods.description: Sets the content of a voicemail from InputStream or byte array, updating MIME type and content presence.

methods.name: findVoicemailBySourceData
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail object matching a specific source data string.

methods.name: findVoicemailByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail object based on its URI.

methods.name: getUriForVoicemailWithId
methods.description: Constructs a URI for a voicemail with the specified ID.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Retrieves all voicemails with optional filtering and sorting.
